Class RegistrationVisitor

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am02.server.model.effect.RegistrationVisitor
All Implemented Interfaces:
EffectVisitor
public class RegistrationVisitor extends Object implements EffectVisitor
Concrete EffectVisitor that registers building effects with the appropriate observer lists in the current Game and Tribu.

Called once per building acquisition via Tribu.insertBuilding(String, Player, Game).
